City of Chicago
                                                                   02022-3729
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                  11/16/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Misc. Transmittal
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Amendment of ordinance (02022-1869) Zoning
                              Reclassification Map No. 14-H at 1920-1924 W 59th St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE

         BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

       SECTION 1. 02022-1869, concerning 1920-24 W. 59'^ St., is hereby amended by
adding the language underscored, as follows:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all ofthe M1-1, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-H in the area bounded by

The Alley next north of and parallel to west 59 Street; a line 57.39 feet east of and parallel to
south Winchester Avenue; west 59th Street; And south Winchester Avenue.

to those of a Cl-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

                           (Omitted text is unaffected by this ordinance)

      SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in full force and effect following due passage and
approval.
